filter.health_condition: male in his seventies with cystic fibrosis, acute-on-chronic pulmonary exacerbation caused by multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa

projects.intervention_detail: Intravenous two-phage cocktail (P1A and PYO2) under an FDA/IRB-approved compassionate-use framework: test infusion 2x10^7 PFU escalating to 2x10^8 PFU every 8 h for 14 days, alongside clinically prescribed ciprofloxacin, in one man with cystic fibrosis.

papers.title: Ecological partitioning enables phage-antibiotic cooperation in a human Pseudomonas infection.

projects.title: Phage-Antibiotic Cooperation Emerges Through Ecological Partitioning in Heterogeneous Pseudomonas Infection
